        "Create a two‑column cheat‑sheet: left column – term (instance, schema, relation, state); right column – precise textbook definition.",
        "For each term, write one original example (e.g., an instance of a student table) and compare it with the definition of a schema.",
        "Review the cheat‑sheet daily for 10 minutes until you can recite each definition verbatim."

        "Adopt a systematic elimination process: read the question, then read *all* options before considering any answer.",
        "Mark each option as ‘definitely wrong’, ‘maybe’, or ‘definitely right’ based on the cheat‑sheet definitions.",
        "Practice this process with at least 5 new syllabus questions per day, documenting why each eliminated option is incorrect."

        "Review the mind‑map weekly to reinforce the relationships."
